identity.title: Reduce first-time developer burden across Shell, Recipe, Pipeline Review, verification tools, and structure

origin.kind: explicit user request and five-minute heartbeat schedule
origin.summary: The user requested sequential refactoring of the five areas identified as most burdensome to a first-time developer, without waiting indefinitely for user input or hardware-dependent verification.

state.current_summary: PL-0018 is complete. M1 Shell, M2 RecipeCommandSurface, M3 Pipeline Review, M4 verification-tool/product navigation, and M5 final MVVM/partial/folder/module audit were all evidenced. The only tracked documentation change is the concise product-versus-verification route plus the final reassessment report; no production C# or XAML changed. Existing concrete owners and contracts remain canonical. Remaining debt is the known RoiImageCanvasViewModel UI/IO coupling and unverified full WPF/device/long-run runtime rows.

objective.summary: Sequentially reduce first-time developer navigation cost while preserving existing behavior, concrete owners, MVVM contracts, image/resource lifetime, and verification boundaries.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; keep C:\Git\2D\Original read-only.
Do not reopen resolved owners without a new reproducible defect, explicit requirement, failed criterion, or changed dependency boundary.
Do not add speculative Interface, Manager, Factory, Provider, EventBus, wrapper, folder, or manual partial layers.
Do not wait indefinitely for user input, camera, SDK, GPU, monitor, DPI, theme, or long-running native execution; record those limits as unverified.
Run only focused checks relevant to the current slice and store generated evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not run tag, release, deploy, or external push from the heartbeat.

criteria.text: Each of the five slices has a recorded current owner, intended owner or no-change decision, actual call path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, and junior reading route.
Any source change moves a real responsibility or fixes a reproduced defect; name-only, file-length-only, and duplicate abstraction changes are rejected.
Every accepted source change passes its focused contract/test, required build, and static stale-coupling or ownership checks; skipped runtime boundaries are explicitly recorded.
The final slice records the updated junior assessment, remaining technical debt, and a comparison with the pre-schedule burden findings.

evidence.observation: The current Shell composition owner, call path, mutable-state writers, lifetime owners, preserved contracts, and junior reading route were recorded. The existing PL-0014 boundary remains sufficient; no new independent owner is justified.

Invoke-RefactorAudit.ps1 -Verify returned REFACTOR_AUDIT=PASS with CSharpFiles=816, XamlFiles=60, PartialDeclarations=59, PartialTextMatches=2, ViewModelUiIoFiles=1, ProjectCycles=0, and ShellStorageCalls=0; git diff --check produced no output. Existing PL-0014 Debug/Release and focused Shell lifecycle/readiness evidence was reused because source behavior did not change.

RecipeCommandSurface was confirmed as the binding-facing state and command owner. Existing execution session, step-edit session, pipeline exchange/lifecycle, validation, run-history, review, and qualified-snapshot owners already provide concrete boundaries. Shared bindings, callbacks, selection state, command-state notifications, and Shell lifetime prevent a safe mechanical split.

The static region/field/dependency survey and direct persistence-owner search completed; git diff --check produced no output. Existing PL-0013/D4-D5 and PL-0015-PL-0017 Recipe/Review build and focused contract evidence remains applicable because this slice made no source change, and no new build was claimed.

Pipeline Review owner map and shortest call path were confirmed: Document owns composition/selected state, ExecutionController owns run/cancel/summaries/cache, RevisionGate owns freshness, LayerImageOwner owns short-lived snapshots, ViewModel owns binding projections, and View owns UI-only interaction/display state. Existing contracts and lifetime boundaries remain explicit.

Invoke-RefactorAudit.ps1 -Verify returned REFACTOR_AUDIT=PASS with CSharpFiles=816, XamlFiles=60, PartialDeclarations=59, PartialTextMatches=2, ViewModelUiIoFiles=1, ProjectCycles=0, and ShellStorageCalls=0; git diff --check produced no output. No source changed, so no new build or runtime PASS was claimed; existing R28 focused Debug/Release Pipeline Review evidence remains applicable.

The product entry/execution path, headless contract runner, WPF screenshot runner, and conditional embedded DirectSmokeRunner were mapped. OpenVisionLabEnableEmbeddedSmokeRunner defaults false; only the opt-in build links smoke sources into the product, preserving the existing --smoke compatibility seam. No new source boundary was justified.

docs/README.md received the concise product-versus-verification route. TestDocumentationIndex.ps1 passed (IndexedPaths=293, Routes=16, RootRedirects=102), Invoke-RefactorAudit.ps1 -Verify passed, and git diff --check reported no whitespace errors. No product C# or XAML changed; no build or runtime PASS was claimed.

Final source-wide audit confirmed 816 C# files, 60 XAML files, 59 framework/cohesive partial declarations, 27 projects with 34 references and cycle 0, dense folders aligned with feature responsibility, and no manual business partial or unproven new owner. The final first-time developer route and remaining RoiImageCanvasViewModel debt are documented.

Debug and Release solution builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; Debug and Release OpenVisionReadinessCheck completed 13/13 OK; TestDocumentationIndex passed with IndexedPaths=294, Routes=16, RootRedirects=102; RefactorAudit passed; issue ledger validated; git diff --check found no whitespace errors. Runtime hardware/theme/DPI/long-run rows remain explicitly unverified.

events.summary: Use one heartbeat executor, one slice per run, no indefinite user or hardware wait, and close the automation after M1-M5 are evidenced.
M3 found no reproducible Pipeline Review defect or new independent boundary. Preserve the existing execution, revision, image, binding, and UI owners; do not add a mechanical split or partial.

M4 confirmed the smoke/product boundary. Keep the conditional embedded runner for existing --smoke compatibility, preserve standalone verification clients, and add a concise docs/README navigation route instead of moving large files mechanically.

M5 found no failed MVVM, manual-partial, folder, project-cycle, image-lifetime, or ownership criterion. Preserve the existing concrete owners and close the five-area schedule with the known RoiImageCanvasViewModel follow-up and runtime verification limits recorded.
All five PL-0018 milestones are evidenced and the scheduled refactoring/reassessment is complete.
